contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could have been done, but Owen said he needed a customer-specific number for Diane, a session to build it was never held, and the cost was never added up.
Rep says Diane froze everything, not us, but also reports finance saw it as nice to have and that Diane was likely never told the cost, which suggests a business-case gap.
Rep names Diane as the final decider but never spoke to her, she was in no meetings, and all knowledge comes secondhand from Owen.
Rep first says she doesn't know that anything got silence, then names the revenue framing, which Owen explicitly rejected.
Rep says paper was sent and they were near procurement, yet migration and payback questions were still open.
Rep says it is timing and will return next year, yet the engineering lead said no billing changes before renewal season and the business case was unbuilt.
Rep states flatly there was no competitor, then qualifies it with 'as far as I know'.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this wasn't going to close? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Pointed to the freeze email and a self-corrected procurement status; the payback ask only came out on follow-up at T20.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got silence?
dodges.what: Said she did not know anything got silence, then offered the revenue framing as a guess.

dodges.question: Who made the final call, and how do you know?
dodges.what: Answered with a hedged guess ('I guess?') and reframed to 'she decided against everything' rather than confirming a decision about us.

dodges.question: Anything else?
dodges.what: Closed with 'nothing we could have done', which conflicts with the unmet asks described earlier.

outcome_signals.what: Effectively a no-decision: Diane froze all new vendor projects after the Q3 miss; paper had been sent but nothing was signed.

Rep expects the deal may return next year.
Not a partial move; nothing moved. Owen was urgent but finance saw it as non-urgent.
